decision.rejectedGenericGuard: A simple positive-area intersection change or tag+CSS empty-container admission cannot reliably exclude a closed ShadowRoot on a standard DIV. Null shadowRoot is none-or-closed, not proof of no foreign paint. Keep the existing conservative source behavior.
decision.selectedLayout: Use ordinary CSS spacing on the already explicit owned Overlay part. Do not ignore it by ref/attribute, hide it, skip its subtree or change source rules.
decision.layoutHypothesis: The recorded mount origin equals Trigger.bottom and lies in its 9px expansion. An actual 16px margin would move that zero-height origin 7px beyond the expansion. mt-4 uses authored CSS spacing; actual computed margin, stage growth and popup placement must be remeasured.
decision.positioningOwner: packages/prototypes/base/src/select/content.proto.ts syncPosition retains strategy fixed and sideOffset props; margin does not author another sideOffset. Native coordinates are pending.
decision.layoutEffects: The mount follows Flow; its margin does not edit Trigger borderbox/hitbox CSS. It can increase stage flow height and move later stages. Narrow, RTL and 200% font effects remain original native acceptance.
